title: Life transitions often reshape identity quietly
excerpt: Relocation, family changes, relationship shifts, and new life stages do not only change external circumstances — they quietly reshape identity.

body.text: Relocation, family changes, relationship shifts, and new life stages do not only change external circumstances — they quietly reshape identity.
This process is often not linear. People may feel stable on the outside while internally adjusting to a new sense of self.
In this space, it is common to question decisions, roles, and even personal direction.
Coaching in these moments is not about pushing for answers, but about creating space where internal alignment can gradually emerge.
